changes: Unify column task augmentation, residual evaluation, projection and selection under one per-yield scope.
Evaluate vector predicates against partition-augmented batches and admit masks and gathered storage.
Use admitted materialization plans and scoped scalar evaluation when vector predicates cannot execute; release row workspace before yielding selected vectors.
Remove raw selection-index arrays and row-to-column fallback reconstruction.

validation.real_fixtures: Parquet partition predicates using vector equality and scalar LIKE; empty result and early close cleanup; existing task and work-unit fixtures.

limitations: Scalar fallback currently admits a full batch of materialized rows; configured budgets can reject this workspace. A streaming per-row fallback may reduce peak memory.
Materialization-plan traversal bookkeeping and other generic helper internals still require allocation coverage audit.
Planning topology, full release gates and the complete mixed-job 64/128 MiB matrix remain open.
No whole-process or production Cloudflare heap-cap claim.
